summary: Implemented SHACL path parsing. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with parse_shacl_path and SHACLPathError, and test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py with one parametrized test covering valid and invalid shapes plus a check that the graph is unchanged. The new tests and the existing test/test_path.py pass (38 passed) under the provided venv. Deviation: I added an explicit non-Node guard so None is not treated as a graph wildcard. Not verified: black, isort, ruff and mypy are not installed in the venv, so formatting and type-ignore placement were checked by reading only. Nothing is committed.
